alternatives.reason: cross-family isotropic alternative, statistically tied with gaussian:2 on k=3 (pair1 +0.01 dB, pair2 -0.05 dB, pair0 -0.10 dB) and better CI (7/8/9 vs 6/4/8); Wiener kernel corr 0.703 still <0.9 so exact PSF unmatched

milder severity backup supported by simulation inversion (target gm_ratio 0.649 / variance_ratio 0.945 sit between gaussian sev1 and sev2; gaussian:2 simulation over-blurs with gm 0.442 / variance_ratio 0.905), but PSNR is 0.33-0.61 dB lower than sev2 on all three pairs

analysis.ci_pass_rate: R0 gaussian:2: pair0 6/10; pair1 4/10; pair2 8/10. R1 best CI: lens:1 9/9/9, lens:2 7/8/9
analysis.mode: PSNR (noise_prior sigma 0.74/1.11/0.74 < 2 -> NO_NOISE); R1 signal-mode noise screen was WEAK with noise:sigma diff=1467% and structured_residual FWHM=4.0px, confirming no noise component

simulation_inversion_pair0.method: run_full_analysis on simulate(clean, blur_gaussian:2) vs clean, compared with run_full_analysis on target vs clean
simulation_inversion_pair0.conclusion: gaussian:2 over-blurs; target is milder than sev2 and is bracketed by legal sev1/sev2. unique_G, chroma, clipping and mean shift are fully explained by blur + content, so quantization / brightness / saturation / contrast steps are excluded. Any global scaling that would raise gm_ratio back to 0.649 would also raise variance_ratio by the same factor, moving it away from 0.945, so blur+global combinations are quantitatively excluded.

noise_recheck.signal_mode_screen: blur_gaussian:2,noise_gaussian_RGB:1 -> WEAK; matched only blur:spectral_slope; noise:sigma diff=1467%; structured_residual FWHM=4.0px
noise_recheck.conclusion: NO_NOISE; peeled residual is structured blur-mismatch, not random noise

analysis.rationale: k=3 support signals agree on a single mild isotropic blur (gm_ratio 0.649/0.519/0.571, spectral_slope_ratio 1.04-1.06, block_boundary 1.012/1.001/0.981, sigma 0.74/1.11/0.74). R1 simulation inversion shows R0's gaussian:2 is slightly too strong (target second-order statistics sit between legal sev1 and sev2), but no legal x_distortion blur reproduces the target: k=3 PSNR stays 24.3-32.6 dB, and R1's newly validated candidates (glass:1 24.29/26.69/30.45; lens:1 25.15/28.61/32.32; lens:2 25.61/29.00/32.55; gaussian:1 25.10/28.68/32.27) all fail the +2 dB CHANGE threshold versus R0's gaussian:2 (25.71/28.99/32.60). Global, quantization and noise steps are excluded by the simulation inversion and signal-mode screen. Therefore NO_CHANGE per protocol; blur_gaussian:2 is retained as the best legal approximation (verdict UNCERTAIN), with lens:2 as the tied cross-family alternative (best CI) and gaussian:1 as the signal-supported milder severity backup.
